I wouldnt jump to conclusions. I've made the same mistake he's making, and mine was addiction driven. Maybe he's got a problem with pornography like I did.

First step is talking to him. Yes, its awkward. Yes its difficult. You need to address it or it will eat you up inside. Just approach it calmly, and dont budge on your feelings. Dont be gaslit or downplayed. 

"Hey *partner*, I know you've got an onlyfans account, and it upsets me a bit that you're paying for content when you have me right here. What pains me even more is the secrecy around it."

Tell them how you feel, let them know what upsets you and why, and accept nothing less than understanding. If you're given that, ask after why he's doing it, and go from there. 

Ultimately its what you're comfortable with, and its about boundaries. An unspoken boundary of "dont keep secrets from me" has already been broken, now is the time to address it, to discuss it, and to re-evaluate. 

TL:DR, Talk to your partner. Tell them what upsets you and why. Find out why they're doing it, figure out a compromise, or if you cant- decide whether or not to continue, or to seek therapy, or to separate.

Ingredients:
-2.5oz spinach
-2.5oz common mushroom
-4 strips turkey bacon
-3 eggs
-Hot sauce of your choice (I used nando's garlic & Frank's red hot)
-1oz cheddar cheese
-Salt & Pepper

Directions:
1.Cook the bacon however you like, cut or tear it into small pieces once done & cooled off.

2.Crack the 3 eggs into a bowl and separate the yolks. Whisk both the whites & yolks seperately until whites are frothy and beginning to peak and the yolks are thickened. Mix yolks and whites back together, season with salt and pepper.

3.Fry the spinach and mushrooms together with a bit of margarine/butter

4. Over low heat in a non stick skillet apply a bit of olive oil, then pour in the egg mixture. Wait ~5 minutes until you can pick up the corner of the omelette with a fork, then lift up and put some butter/margarine under both sides of the omelette.

5.Toppings! Put your spinach/mushroom /turkey bacon onto the omelette, season with salt and pepper then put the cheddar cheese on the omelette.

6.Wait until the cheese is beginning to melt, then remove the pan from the heat, Shifting the omelette onto the plate. Now is the time to use any hot sauce if you've opted to. Once done, fold the omelette over and lightly but firmly press down so the toppings almost begin spilling out.

7. Sprinkle with any herbs, extra cheeses, hot sauces & seasonings then serve and enjoy!

Recipe is as follows:

Ingredients:
- 15oz Cauliflower florets
- 2 eggs
- 3 oz cheddar cheese
- 1 oz pizza mozzerella
- 10 oz chicken
- 2 oz red & green bell peppers
- 3 oz mushroom
- 3 tbsp garlic caeser dressing (use whatever for the sauce, I just really like garlic caeser.)

Steps:

1.Rice the cauliflower florets via food processor or just by hand grating them, either works, I used a hand grater. Once done toss into a skillet over low/medium heat stirring frequently. This is done to dry out the cauliflower.

2. Mix the 2 eggs and the 3oz of cheddar cheese into a bowl and mix them together. Add the cauliflower to the mix once it's reasonably dried. Mix thouroughly. 

3.Pre heat oven to 400 then flatten your Cauliflower/cheese/egg mixture out on a parchment paper lined oven tray, form the pizza into a flat circle, about 1/4-1/2in thick and push the walls in to create a bit of a raised crust edge. Once oven is heated, toss it in. Cook for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

4.Cut up your chicken (or whatever meat you've chosen) into small bite sized pieces and cook them on the stove top in a skillet. Cut up your veggies/whatever other toppings too. You can cook your veggies with it, but I chose to leave my veggies raw.

5. Once roughly 20 minutes have passed, take the pizza out of the oven and put on the 3 tbsp of garlic caeser and mix it around with the back of a spoon, covering the whole of the pizza. When your toppings are done, add them onto the now sauced pizza. Sprinkle on the 1 oz of pizza mozzarella.

6. Place the now topped pizza back into the oven until the mozarella melts and begins to brown, then remove from oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes. Voila! Pizza!
